text:
Priya: huge shoutout to @Ben and @Lila for the last-minute slide rescue right before the investor call. you two are absolute legends :sparkles:
Ben: phew. grabbed the diagram, cleaned up the bullets, and removed one terrifying clipart. glad it landed okay. also shoutout to Sam for staying on chat the whole time :muscle:
Lila: team effort! i did a frantic copy-paste from Figma while on the tram. apologies for the tiny font on slide 7, but the point came through :sweat_smile: :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Sam: stayed queued for live comments and sent a backup PDF. also flung three morale stickers into the presentation deck mid-call :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye: :star2:
NightOpsBot: [automated] Backup created: slides_backup_2867000001_v2.pdf at 21:05. Incident channel ping suppressed.
Priya: seriously can't thank you all enough. the Q&A was calm, we didn't have to whiteboard anything sheepishly :relieved:
Ben: extra thanks to NightOpsBot for the backup nudge. small infra things are the unsung heroes.
Lila: also, shoutout to the sticker brigade for adding a tiny llama to the roadmap slide. investors smiled. that's all we needed :llama:
Sam: i'll leave a bag of celebratory stickers on Priya's desk tomorrow. claim them before the office dogs do :dog:
Priya: love that. stickers and coffee on me for the heroes of slide 7 tomorrow morning. meetup at 10? :coffee:
Ben: 10 works. i'll bring the glue dots and existential calm. :thumbsup:
Lila: thanks team. little rescue missions make the week feel human. :heart:
Priya: posting this as an official kudos: Ben, Lila, Sam, and NightOpsBot ":heroes-of-the-deck" award. try not to let it go to your heads :trophy:
